summary: Banco Bradesco filed a Form 6-K with its quarterly earnings press release for 2Q26. The report discusses recurring net income of R$7.1 bi, up 16.2% year-over-year, and revenues of R$37.6 bi. It is a routine financial results disclosure with no special-situation elements such as M&A, restructuring, or capital actions. The filing is routine for a foreign private issuer.
